auditor.name: M/s. N.A Shah Associates LLP (resigned May 14, 2026); M/s S K Patodia & Associates LLP (appointed May 14, 2026)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: 1. Non-compliance with Sections 73 and 74 of Companies Act, 2013 regarding outstanding interest-free unsecured loan liability of ₹98.50 lakhs from a member as on March 31, 2026. 2. Accumulated losses, net worth fully eroded, current liabilities exceed current assets indicating material uncertainty about going concern; financial statements prepared on going concern basis based on promoter commitment to infuse funds.

Non-payment of annual listing fees within prescribed period
Website not updated as per Regulation 46 of SEBI LODR
Board meeting outcomes not uploaded to stock exchange

Newspaper advertisements missing QR codes and webpage details as per Regulation 47(1)
